<function name="GetWorldPanel" parent="vgui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns the global world panel which is the parent to all others, except for the HUD panel.

See also <page>Global.GetHUDPanel</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Panel">The world panel</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
